coverage_gaps: The authorized routes omit Embase and other subscription indexes, so journal coverage and conference-abstract recall may be incomplete.

No general citation-graph or DOI metadata route is available for systematic forward-citation chasing; PubMed related records, registry links, study identifiers, and author searches must serve as proxies.
No dedicated retraction database or publisher-version-history route is available; evidence-integrity conclusions require cautious interpretation when PubMed and FDA provide no notice.
No EMA or other non-US regulator route is available, limiting comparison of international regulatory interpretations and action dates.
FDA internal review packages, unpublished sponsor analyses, individual participant data, and complete case-report forms may remain inaccessible.
ClinicalTrials.gov may expose the current record more readily than every historical version, which can limit reconstruction of amendment timing.
Postauthorization observational evidence may have residual confounding, channeling, outcome-definition heterogeneity, and limited power for rare cancers or thrombotic events.
ORAL Surveillance enrolled a cardiovascular risk-enriched population aged 50 years or older, so direct generalization to younger or lower-risk rheumatoid-arthritis populations remains limited.
exclusion_criteria: Exclude records first published or substantively issued after 2024-12-31 from the as-of assessment, while logging them as post-cutoff discoveries if encountered.
Exclude efficacy-only reports that provide no decision-relevant safety result, subgroup context, or exposure denominator.
Exclude animal, in vitro, chemistry, and mechanism-only studies unless they are directly cited by FDA as support for a regulatory safety conclusion.
Exclude pediatric and non-rheumatoid-arthritis studies lacking direct relevance to the marketed rheumatoid-arthritis safety question.
Exclude uncontrolled anecdotes and single case reports from comparative risk estimation; retain only when they document a regulatory trigger absent from higher-level evidence.
Exclude narrative commentary that merely repeats another source when the primary study, registry record, or FDA action is available.
Exclude records that mention JAK inhibitors as a class without separable tofacitinib evidence, except when necessary to define the scope of an FDA class-wide action.
Exclude duplicate publication manifestations after identifier reconciliation while preserving all query-to-record and registry-to-publication links.
Exclude claims whose outcome definition, comparator, dose, or study population cannot be resolved after checking the primary record.

Exclude corrected or retracted values from final extraction when a valid replacement exists; preserve the original record, integrity status, correction relationship, and reason for replacement in the evidence ledger.
inclusion_criteria: Include records published, posted, or effectively updated on or before 2024-12-31; tag online-first, issue, registry-posting, and regulatory-effective dates separately.
Include the complete ClinicalTrials.gov record and available version history for NCT02092467, including protocol fields, amendments, results, adverse events, and linked publications.
Include the primary peer-reviewed ORAL Surveillance publication and secondary analyses reporting cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, mortality, dose, or subgroup results.
Include FDA safety communications, boxed-warning decisions, prescribing-information changes, and supporting reviews that explicitly concern tofacitinib or use ORAL Surveillance evidence.

Include adult rheumatoid-arthritis randomized trials, comparative observational studies, registries, systematic reviews, and meta-analyses that can corroborate, qualify, or conflict with the pivotal findings.
Include evidence that distinguishes the 5-mg twice-daily rheumatoid-arthritis dose, the 10-mg twice-daily study arm, and approved extended-release dosing.
Include effect estimates with denominators, event definitions, comparator, follow-up, confidence intervals, and analysis population whenever available.
Include null, negative, conflicting, correction, erratum, retraction, expression-of-concern, and superseding regulatory records.

Include non-rheumatoid-arthritis evidence only when it directly explains an FDA class action, dose-specific warning, biological plausibility, or labeling scope relevant to marketed tofacitinib in rheumatoid arthritis.
Retain every query-hit occurrence while deduplicating canonical records by NCT number, PMID, DOI, FDA document identity, title, and date; fail closed when duplicate records conflict.

queries.purpose: Recover the pivotal registry record and capture sponsor study number, design, population, interventions, comparator, prespecified outcomes, enrollment, dates, amendments, and posted results.
Recover the primary ORAL Surveillance publication and establish registry-publication linkage using title, trial identifier, and sponsor study number.
queries.query: ("NCT02092467"[All Fields] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR "A3921133"[All Fields] OR "Cardiovascular and Cancer Risk with Tofacitinib in Rheumatoid Arthritis"[Title]) AND ("1900/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Recover the principal FDA communication summarizing final trial conclusions and identify linked labeling and earlier communications.
queries.query: site:fda.gov/drugs/drug-safety-and-availability tofacitinib ORAL Surveillance NCT02092467 heart-related events cancer blood clots death

queries.purpose: Maximize recall for peer-reviewed rheumatoid-arthritis safety evidence covering all decision-relevant outcomes.
queries.query: (("Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[Mesh] OR "rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Tofacitinib"[Mesh] OR tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract] OR "CP-690,550"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Drug-Related Side Effects and Adverse Reactions"[Mesh] OR safety[Title/Abstract] OR cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer*[Title/Abstract] OR thromb*[Title/Abstract] OR embol*[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR death[Title/Abstract])) AND ("1900/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Identify related interventional and postmarketing studies that may qualify generalizability, dose effects, longer-term safety, or incomplete evidence.
queries.query: AREA[ConditionSearch] "Rheumatoid Arthritis" AND AREA[InterventionSearch] (tofacitinib OR Xeljanz) AND (AREA[OverallStatus] COMPLETED OR AREA[OverallStatus] TERMINATED OR AREA[OverallStatus] WITHDRAWN OR AREA[OverallStatus] ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING)

queries.purpose: Retrieve the dated sequence of FDA alerts, boxed-warning changes, class-wide actions, indication restrictions, and supporting rationale.
queries.query: site:fda.gov tofacitinib Xeljanz boxed warning pulmonary embolism thrombosis malignancy cardiovascular mortality 2019 2021

queries.purpose: Confirm primary cardiovascular and malignancy findings, noninferiority framework, effect estimates, event counts, confidence intervals, and analysis populations.
queries.query: ("NCT02092467"[All Fields] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("major adverse cardiovascular events"[Title/Abstract] OR MACE[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer*[Title/Abstract] OR noninferior*[Title/Abstract]) AND ("1900/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Retrieve trial analyses relevant to venous thromboembolism, pulmonary embolism, dose response, and all-cause mortality.
queries.query: (("NCT02092467"[All Fields] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Venous Thromboembolism"[Mesh] OR thrombo*[Title/Abstract] OR "pulmonary embolism"[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR death[Title/Abstract])) AND ("1900/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Confirm registered primary and secondary endpoints, arm definitions, disposition, adverse-event tables, result-posting dates, and changes across registry versions.
queries.query: AREA[NCTId] NCT02092467

queries.purpose: Recover the 2019 FDA action prompted by pulmonary embolism and mortality observations in the higher-dose arm and preserve its contemporaneous scope.
queries.query: site:fda.gov "FDA approves Boxed Warning" Xeljanz tofacitinib blood clots death 10 mg twice daily 2019

queries.purpose: Recover preliminary and final 2021 FDA communications, their evidence maturity, affected products, warnings, and clinical recommendations.
queries.query: site:fda.gov tofacitinib "serious heart-related events" cancer blood clots death February 2021 September 2021 Drug Safety Communication

queries.purpose: Find secondary analyses that identify effect modifiers, competing risks, risk-enriched subgroups, and limits on extrapolation.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR "NCT02092467"[All Fields] OR "A3921133"[All Fields]) AND (subgroup*[Title/Abstract] OR risk factor*[Title/Abstract] OR smoking[Title/Abstract] OR "65 years"[Title/Abstract] OR ASCVD[Title/Abstract] OR incidence[Title/Abstract] OR infection*[Title/Abstract]) AND ("1900/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Retrieve external comparative evidence, including STAR-RA-type multidatabase analyses, that may corroborate or qualify cardiovascular findings.
queries.query: (("rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract]) AND (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract]) AND ("TNF inhibitor"[Title/Abstract] OR adalimumab[Title/Abstract] OR etanercept[Title/Abstract]) AND (cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR MACE[Title/Abstract]) AND (cohort[Title/Abstract] OR observational[Title/Abstract] OR "real world"[Title/Abstract] OR database[Title/Abstract] OR meta-analysis[Publication Type])) AND ("1900/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Retrieve comparative observational and synthesized evidence for malignancy, thrombosis, and mortality, including null or discordant estimates.
queries.query: (("rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract]) AND tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] AND (malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer*[Title/Abstract] OR thrombo*[Title/Abstract] OR "pulmonary embolism"[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract]) AND (cohort[Title/Abstract] OR observational[Title/Abstract] OR registry[Title/Abstract] OR meta-analysis[Publication Type] OR systematic review[Title/Abstract])) AND ("1900/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Collect publications and references linked from the registry, then reconcile them with PubMed identifiers while preserving every registry-to-publication link.
queries.query: AREA[NCTId] NCT02092467 AND AREA[StudyType] INTERVENTIONAL

queries.purpose: Determine whether corrections, errata, retractions, or expressions of concern alter extraction, interpretation, or admissibility of the primary and secondary evidence.
queries.query: ("Cardiovascular and Cancer Risk with Tofacitinib in Rheumatoid Arthritis"[Title] OR "NCT02092467"[All Fields] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract]) AND (Correction[Publication Type] OR Retracted Publication[Publication Type] OR Retraction of Publication[Publication Type] OR Published Erratum[Publication Type] OR correction[Title] OR erratum[Title] OR corrigendum[Title] OR retraction[Title] OR "expression of concern"[Title]) AND ("1900/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Actively seek null, negative, conflicting, and bias-focused evidence that could qualify the pivotal trial or FDA interpretation.
queries.query: ((tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract]) AND "rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract] AND (cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR thrombo*[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract]) AND (null[Title/Abstract] OR "no increased risk"[Title/Abstract] OR inconsistent[Title/Abstract] OR conflicting[Title/Abstract] OR limitation*[Title/Abstract] OR bias[Title/Abstract])) AND ("1900/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Check whether FDA corrected, superseded, clarified, or materially updated a safety communication or label interpretation.
queries.query: site:fda.gov tofacitinib Xeljanz correction update revised communication labeling error ORAL Surveillance

queries.purpose: Capture publications, integrity notices, and interpretive updates appearing after the primary report through the as-of cutoff.
queries.query: (("rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract]) AND (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract]) AND ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR thrombo*[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR correction[Title] OR retraction[Title])) AND ("2022/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Detect registry changes posted after the primary publication through the as-of date and compare them with earlier registered content.
queries.query: AREA[NCTId] NCT02092467 AND AREA[LastUpdatePostDate] RANGE[01/01/2022, 12/31/2024]

queries.purpose: Capture FDA label or safety updates from 2022 through 2024 and determine whether they modify the 2021 regulatory position.
queries.query: site:fda.gov tofacitinib Xeljanz safety label 2022..2024 cardiovascular malignancy thrombosis mortality

question_frame: PECO safety frame: among adults with rheumatoid arthritis, emphasizing patients aged 50 years or older with at least one cardiovascular risk factor, assess marketed tofacitinib at rheumatoid-arthritis doses and the 10-mg twice-daily trial arm versus tumor necrosis factor inhibitors or other active comparators through 2024-12-31. Link the pivotal postauthorization ORAL Surveillance study to ClinicalTrials.gov NCT02092467, its primary publication, secondary analyses, and dated FDA actions. Evaluate major adverse cardiovascular events, malignancy excluding nonmelanoma skin cancer, venous and arterial thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, all-cause mortality, dose effects, absolute and relative risks, subgroup modifiers, external observational or synthesized evidence, and correction or retraction status.
stop_rules: Complete all sentinel, discovery, confirmation, expansion, challenge, and update queries across pubmed, clinicaltrials_gov, and fda_regulatory.

Do not stop until NCT02092467, the primary ORAL Surveillance publication, the 2019 FDA higher-dose thrombosis and mortality action, and the 2021 preliminary and final FDA actions are recovered or a documented route failure explains each missing anchor.

Stop registry-publication reconciliation only after NCT number, sponsor study number, trial title, interventions, enrollment, dates, and primary outcomes agree or every discrepancy has been escalated and recorded.
Require direct evidence coverage for cardiovascular events, malignancy, thrombosis or pulmonary embolism, and all-cause mortality, with dose and comparator context for each outcome.

Require at least one targeted external-evidence search per outcome domain and an explicit account of population, comparator, follow-up, confounding, and precision before labeling evidence corroborating or conflicting.

Run integrity searches for the primary publication and all decision-changing secondary analyses; stop only after PubMed publication-type links and FDA update or correction searches have been checked through 2024-12-31.
Perform backward, linked-record, author or study-number, and forward-topic expansion in two consecutive waves; stop expansion when both waves add no new decision-relevant canonical record.
Apply the temporal cutoff after retrieval whenever provider date syntax is ambiguous and document indexing lag separately from the underlying publication or action date.
Stop when additional retrieval cannot change the direction, certainty, applicability, regulatory chronology, or evidence-integrity handling of the assessment.
If a source is unavailable or the planned retrieval budget is exhausted, stop that route only after logging the failed query, unresolved anchors, expected impact, and residual coverage gap.
